title: ADR Trigger Evaluation in the Supervisor

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given config/adr-triggers.json and a step output, When the supervisor evaluates the triggers after ingest, Then a multi-module change and a new shared component each match their declared condition.
Given a step output matching no trigger, When evaluation runs, Then nothing is reported, so a quiet step stays quiet.
Given a trigger condition the evaluator does not recognise, When it is evaluated, Then it fails naming the condition rather than silently matching nothing.
Given the trigger conditions adr-triggers.json declares, When they are inspected, Then every one is read by the evaluator, proven by test (ADR-0007).
